source.name: SailGP team page - Red Bull Italy (team name/identity)
Pressmare: Red Bull Italy SailGP welcomes Azimut as Global Partner
source.quote: joins the team as Global Partner for the upcoming 2026 Rolex SailGP Championship
source.note: The team's own announcement ('By Red Bull Ita SailGP Team'). SailGP's team page (sailgp.com/teams/red-bull-italy/) lists Azimut as the team's only Global Partner.

summary: Red Bull is in the team's name itself rather than a bought placement; Azimut, the asset and wealth management group, is the team's Global Partner, with the Azimut Investments logo on the hull of the F50. Red Bull also became a SailGP league global partner in January 2026. Not marked complete: only the title sponsor and the Global Partner were checked.
